# Reviewed delivery metadata for immutable commits on main. One line per
# commit: <full-sha> related=<n,m|none> completes=<n,m|none>. A line replaces
# the commit's own metadata (or its absence) when Issue sets are resolved;
# history is never rewritten. Each line needs a human-approved reason above it.
#
# v0.2.0 migration boundary. Two explicitly reviewed legacy completions merged
# before the Completes-Issues contract; each PR closed its Issue with a GitHub
# closing keyword at merge, which is not a release. These records let the
# v0.2.0 publication envelope record each Issue as delivered by v0.2.0
# (release comment, and Project status once enabled); both Issues are already
# closed and are not re-closed. Old closing keywords are not otherwise
# reinterpreted, and no other legacy commit is reconciled; in particular PR
# #145 delivered only I132-T01 and #132 stays incomplete.
